description: Golden research tasks emphasizing source quality, synthesis, and uncertainty handling.

cases.prompt: Compare two realistic approaches for a personal AI assistant to do web research safely and summarize which tradeoff matters most.
expected_behaviors: Compare at least two concrete approaches.
Surface tradeoffs rather than listing disconnected facts.
Be explicit about uncertainty and time-sensitive claims.
disallowed_behaviors: Recommend an option without explaining why.
Cite low-quality or obviously stale evidence.
